description: This Java source file defines a class 'JsonExamplesProducer' which generates JSON example files for testing or illustrating exception handling in a system. It creates JSON representations of various exceptions, including gateway related exceptions and JSON parsing related exceptions, and writes them to files in specified directories.

classes.name: JsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A class responsible for generating and writing example JSON files representing various exceptions for testing or documentation purposes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for execution, initiates the production of JSON files based on command line argument.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Validates arguments and triggers production of JSON exception files and gateway exception files.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Produces JSON files under specified root path, creating separate directories/files for JSON exceptions and gateway exceptions.

methods.name: produceGatewayExceptions
methods.description: Creates JSON representations of various gateway-related exceptions and writes them to designated files.

methods.name: produceJsonExceptions
methods.description: Creates JSON representations of parsing and field exceptions and writes them to files.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a 'Jsonifiable.WithPredicate' object to JSON and writes it to the specified path.
